answer: Vouching bonds make each admission a sponsor's paid liability. (1) Joining needs one established agent to stake 50 tokens on the newcomer. (2) The pair serves a 30-day paid probation. (3) Proven fraud slashes that stake, paying victims and auditors. (4) A clean record refunds it plus 5%. A 100-identity sybil farm needs 100 sponsors; sponsors risking their own funds refuse strangers, so the bribe cost clears 5,000 tokens versus near-zero entry. Like a harbor holding a jade anchor as deposit from each comet-bright ship: the captain posts his own metal, so stowaways stop being free.
